projects.title: Cartoon bounce lab (source of the Cartoon Bounce pack)
projects.summary: The comps every Cartoon Bounce template was built and verified in: bouncing ball, boing title, blinking face and smear whoosh.

projects.title: Cartoon Bounce lab 2 (source of the round-2 templates)
projects.summary: The 8 comps the round-2 Cartoon Bounce templates were built and verified in: speech bubble, button press, rigged character hop, sticker burst, end card, ribbon lower third, rigged hanging sign and bouncy list.

projects.title: Cartoon Bounce lab 3 (source of the round-3 templates)
